aiInsight: Runs internal learning at scale via Infosys Lex and the client-facing Wingspan platform, using virtual labs and gen-AI-powered modules.
Operates the 'Bridge Program' letting employees reskill and change careers internally, trained on real projects.
FY2024-25 strategy pillar explicitly 'Reskill our people', with large-scale digital and generative-AI upskilling.
Recognized as a Global Top Employer for the fourth consecutive year, citing learning and employee experience.
Continued heavy investment in AI/gen-AI capability building across delivery talent for its 'AI Your Enterprise' positioning.
source: Infosys Integrated Annual Report 2024-25 (investor relations) and Wingspan/Lex product pages.

aiInsight: Clocked ~56 million learning hours in FY2024-25, averaging 96.4 learning hours per employee.
Employees acquired 5.2 million competencies and 100,000+ external certifications during the year.
100,000+ employees gained higher-order AI/ML and GenAI skills; ranked #1 in AI & Data certifications across AWS, Google Cloud, Microsoft and GitHub.
402,000+ employees pursued career-linked learning through the TCS Elevate platform.
Deployed AI-driven skilling tools including AI Interview Coach, AI Communications Coach and Fresco Play AI Labs for hands-on practice.
source: TCS Integrated Annual Report 2024-25 (investor relations), human-capital section.

aiInsight: Invests more than US$1 billion per year in learning and professional development for its 700,000+ people.
Delivered roughly 40-47 million training hours in the fiscal year, with heavy emphasis on generative AI.
Trained 600,000+ employees in AI fundamentals and targeted doubling deeply skilled Data & AI practitioners to ~80,000.
Launched Accenture LearnVantage, a technology/data/AI learning service for clients' workforces.
Acquired edtech firm Udacity and committed ~US$1 billion toward scaling AI-focused learning capabilities.
source: Accenture FY2024 Form 10-K (SEC EDGAR) and FY2024 Letter to Shareholders.

aiInsight: Positions itself as an 'AI-powered' services company with large-scale generative-AI upskilling across its 230,000+ global workforce.
Runs structured reskilling and career-development programs through internal learning platforms (TalentNext / learning academies).
Reports human-capital and learning metrics in its FY2024-25 Integrated Annual Report and Sustainability Report.
Emphasizes continuous upskilling in AI, cloud and engineering to align talent with its ai360 strategy.
Invests in inclusion-linked development and workforce skilling per its FY25 Sustainability reports.
source: Wipro Integrated Annual Report 2024-25 and Sustainability Report FY25. Per-employee learning-hour figures not surfaced, so points are qualitative.
